annotations.title: Send a message to an X broadcast chat

description: Post ONE chat message, as the brand, into a RUNNING live broadcast on the connected X account (max 140 characters; a longer one is refused, never cut). It is PUBLIC in front of everyone watching: show the user the exact wording, get a yes, then pass confirm:true. replyTo answers one specific message. Needs X connected with the broadcast permissions added 2026-09-21: an X connection made before then must be reconnected once under Connectors > X (the tool says so without calling X). Costs credits (X bills per call).

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

confirm.description: true only after the user approved this exact message; it is posted publicly

replyTo.description: chat message id to reply to

text.description: chat message, max 140 characters; a longer one is refused

name: send_x_broadcast_chat
title: Send a message to an X broadcast chat
